description: This source file defines the SamplesFontResolver class, which implements the IFontResolver interface to provide font resolution and font data retrieval functionalities for a PDF processing library. It manages font name mappings and loads font byte data from specified asset paths, supporting platform-independent font resolution for PDF samples.

classes.name: SamplesFontResolver
classes.description: Implements custom font resolution logic for PDF sample rendering, providing font name mappings and font file loading capabilities.

methods.name: SamplesFontResolver
methods.description: Constructor that ensures the font assets are at the required version.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves font family names and styles (bold, italic) into specific font resolver info objects.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves the byte array of a font file given its face name, loaded from predefined asset paths.
